arabic text: EK KHUDA E SABRO REZZA, EK WAFAON KA HAI KHUDA
english translation text: One is the Lord of patience and acceptance; one is the lord of loyalty.

arabic text: JAB BHI GAYA ME KARBOBALA, EK HUJOOM THA LOGO KA\nJAGTI AANKHON SE MAINE, JANNAT KA MANZAR DEKHA\nSAJDA SARE BAYNUL HARMAIN, KARTE HUWE YEH DIL NE KAHA
english translation text: Whenever I went to Karbala, I saw a multitude of people.\nWith waking eyes I beheld a scene of Paradise.\nProstrating between the two shrines, my heart said:

arabic text: EK WAQAAR E PAYGHAMBAR, EK BANI HASHIM KA QAMAR\nEK SAWARE DOSHE NABI, EK ALAMDARE LASHKAR\nDONO MERE AQA MOLA, YABNA ALI YABNAZ ZAHRA
english translation text: One bears the dignity of the Prophet; one is the moon of Bani Hashim.\nOne rode upon the Prophet's shoulders; one was the army's standard-bearer.\nBoth are my masters—sons of Ali and Zahra.

arabic text: KARBOBALA ME DONO NE, KHOON SE HAI TAREEKH LIKHI\nEK NE KATWAYE BAZU, EK KE GALE PE TEGH CHALI\nDEEN E RASOOL E HAQ KE LIYE, JAAN HAI KI DONO NE FIDA
english translation text: In Karbala, both wrote history with their blood.\nOne had his arms severed; the other's throat met the sword.\nFor the true religion of the Messenger, both sacrificed their lives.

arabic text: SHAAME GHARIBAAN AA POHNCHI, AALE MOHAMED THE QAIDI\nEK BEHAN PABANDE RASAN, THAME ALAM KO ROTI HUWI\nBHAYI KE LASHON PER AAKAR, PARHTI RAHI YEHI NOHA
english translation text: The evening of loneliness arrived, and Muhammad's family became captives.\nA sister, bound in rope, held the standard and wept.\nStanding over her brothers' bodies, she continued reciting this lament.

arabic text: EK THA SAR NEZE PE RUKA, EK MUSALSAL GIRTA RAHA\nSAATH JO QAIDI CHALTA THA, KARTA RAHA HAR DAM GIRYA\nKHOON THA JARI AANKHON SE, DETE THE SAJJAD SADAA
english translation text: One head remained upon a spear; another kept falling from it.\nThe captive who walked beside them continued weeping.\nBlood flowed from his eyes as Sajjad cried out.

arabic text: EK WOH BACHI MASOOMA, NAAM SAKINA THA JISKA\nKEHTI THI AAJAWO CHACHA, AAO MERE PYAARE BABA\nJAB BHI TAMACHA USKO LAG, KEHKE YEHI ROYI DUKHYA
english translation text: There was an innocent child named Sakina.\nShe called: come, my uncle; come, my beloved Baba.\nWhenever she was slapped, the grieving child wept these words.

arabic text:
FAKHR HAI YEH SALMAN O KARIM, HUM KO MILA YEH SHARF
AZEEM
DONO KE DAR CHOOME HAI, HAI YEH ATA E RABBE RAHEEM
SAANSON ME AUR DADHKAN ME, SHAMIL HAI YEHI JUMLA
english translation text:
O Salman and Karim, we take pride in
receiving this great honour. We kissed both their
doors—this is the gift of the Merciful Lord.
Within our breaths and heartbeats lives this same phrase.

arabic text: ONE IS THE SUN OF SALVATION\nONE IS THE BRIGHT MOUNTAIN OF PATIENCE
english translation text: One is the sun of salvation;\none is the bright mountain of patience.

arabic text:
BY THE SUN AND HIS BRIGHT FACE
BY THE MOON THAT FOLLOWS IN GRACE
BY THE DAY WHEN YOUR THROAT DRIED
BY THE NIGHT WHEN ZAINAB CRIED
WITHOUT OUR MOON AND OUR SUN
HOW TO MADINA CAN WE RETURN.
english translation text:
By the sun and his radiant face,
by the moon that follows him in grace,
by the day when your throat was dry,
by the night when Zainab cried—
without our moon and our sun,
how can we return to Madina?

arabic text:
BY THE HEAVENS THAT CRIED FOR YOU
BY THE BLOOD FROM YOU THEY DREW
BY THE EARTH WHERE YOUR BACK BROKE
BY THE MOONS ON SPEARS THAT SPOKE
BY HIS SEVERED ARMS APART
BY YOUR LONELY BROKEN HEART
english translation text:
By the heavens that wept for you,
by the blood they drew from you,
by the earth where your back was broken,
by the moons upon spears that spoke,
by his severed arms apart,
and by your lonely broken heart.

arabic text:
FROM NAJAF TO KARBOBALA
EACH STEP I CALL OUT YA MAWLA
MY HEART BEATS FOR NAINAWA
MY EYES WEEP FOR ALQAMA
TAKE ME TO BAYNUL HARAMAIN
TO MY ABBAS AND TO MY HUSSAIN
english translation text:
From Najaf to Karbala,
with every step I call: Ya Maula.
My heart beats for Nainawa;
my eyes weep for Alqama.
Take me to Baynul Haramain,
to my Abbas and my Hussain.

arabic text:
WHEN I ARRIVE IN KARBALA
BETWEEN THE DOMES OF MY MASTERS
I LOOK TO MY LEFT AND MY RIGHT
I CALL WITH HEAVEN ON BOTH SIDES
TAKE NOTE ANGELS WHO WRITE MY DEEDS
MY MASTERS ARE THE SONS OF ALI
english translation text:
When I arrive in Karbala,
between the domes of my masters,
I look to my left and right
and call, with Heaven on both sides:
O angels who write my deeds,
record that my masters are the sons of Ali.

arabic text:
SAKINA CRIED INTO THE NIGHT
WHO WILL COME TO AID MY SIDE
SHE CALLED OUT ABBAS TO YOU
AS SHE RAN FROM HORSES HOOVES
WHERE IS MY FATHER AND HIS CHEST WITHOUT YOU NOW HOW
CAN I REST
english translation text:
Sakina cried into the night:
who will come to aid me?
She called out to Abbas
as she ran from the horses' hooves.
Where are my father and his chest?
Without you now, how can I rest?

arabic text:
ZAHRA DESCENDS UPON THE PLAINS EMBRACING THE CHEST OF
HUSSAIN
BY ABBAS’ ARMS SHE STAYS
SHE CALLS IN BAYNUL HARAMAIN
BOTH WERE SLAIN ALONE IN THIRST
WHICH SON’S THIRST SHALL I QUENCH FIRST
english translation text:
Zahra descends upon the plain,
embracing Hussain's chest.
Beside Abbas's arms she remains,
calling in Baynul Haramain:
both were killed alone and thirsty—
which son's thirst should I quench first?

arabic text:
UMMUL BANEEN IN BAQI SHE CRIED WHY
O’ MY MOON HAVE YOU SHIED
ABBAS WHERE DO YOUR ARMS LIE
WHO WAS LEFT BY HUSSAIN’S SIDE
HOW TO ZAHRA WILL I GO
WHEN HER SON WAS LEFT ALONE
english translation text:
In Baqi, Ummul Baneen cried:
why, O my moon, have you disappeared?
Abbas, where do your arms lie?
Who remained beside Hussain?
How can I face Zahra
when her son was left alone?

arabic text:
ABBAS’ FLAG THE MEHDI WILL RAISE
CALLING HUSSAIN’S CALL ON THAT DAY
WHO WILL HELP THE SON OF ALI
THE MAHDI WILL CALL OUT AND PLEAD
I AM THE BLOOD OF ABBAS WHO WAS SLAIN
I AM THE MOON AND THE SON OF HUSSAIN
english translation text:
Mahdi will raise Abbas's standard
and repeat Hussain's call that day:
who will help the son of Ali?
Mahdi will call and plead:
I am the blood of the slain Abbas;
I am the moon and the son of Hussain.
